task: Audit render.md for behavioral reproducibility. Determine whether an implementation of render.md, authored solely from render.md, reproduces render.py on every probe in probes.json — and report every behavior exercised by the probes that render.md either does not determine or determines differently from render.py.
evidence_requirements: E-A: a statement of every behavior on the probe set where render.md either does not determine the output or determines it differently from render.py, or an explicit argument that none exists

E-B: an item-level comparison over probes.json between render.py and an implementation of render.md authored solely from render.md, by an author who has never accessed render.py nor any analysis derived from it; the implementation must be a python file exposing render(p) so the comparison is mechanically reproducible
E-C: the verdict follows from E-A and E-B together: DIVERGES iff the comparison shows a differing output on some probe
